mapper.sql: id, company_id, department_id, login_id, email, password_hash, name, role::text AS role, phone_number, social_provider, social_id, profile_image_url, email_verified, email_verified_at, is_active, token_version, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM users WHERE LOWER(login_id) = LOWER(#{loginId}) LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email}) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LOWER(login_id) = LOWER(#{loginId})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( company_id, department_id, login_id, email, password_hash, name, role, phone_number, social_provider, social_id, profile_image_url, email_verified, email_verified_at, is_active, token_version ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{departmentId}, #{loginId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, CAST(#{role,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} AS user_role_enum), #{phoneNumber}, #{socialProvider,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{socialId}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{emailVerified}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{active}, #{tokenVersion} )

INSERT INTO users ( company_id, department_id, login_id, email, password_hash, name, role, phone_number, social_provider, social_id, profile_image_url, email_verified, email_verified_at, is_active, token_version ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{departmentId}, #{loginId}, #{email}, NULL, #{name}, CAST(#{role,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler} AS user_role_enum), #{phoneNumber}, #{socialProvider,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{socialId}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{emailVerified}, #{emailVerifiedAt}, #{active}, #{tokenVersion} )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET social_provider = #{provider}, social_id = #{socialId}, profile_image_url = COALESCE(#{profileImageUrl}, profile_image_url), email_verified = TRUE, email_verified_at = COALESCE(email_verified_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET token_version = token_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId}
